hooks.name: Anyscale command safety
hooks.description: Replicates the Anyscale agent-skills PreToolUse screen for Kiro. Delegates to the Anyscale-managed hooks/main.sh denylist (recursive rm, dd, mkfs, curl|bash, destructive aws/gcloud/az/kubectl/helm/eksctl/anyscale commands, non-read-only terraform) and blocks the shell tool with exit 2 when it matches. Fails open if the Anyscale hook is not installed.
